% Pattern: proof/in-proof/article. Inside a proof, a claim environment and
% then a proof written as \proof: the proof is the proof of the claim.
% seen in the gold pilot (set X)
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1 status=here
% want proof-1 proof - proves=theorem-1
% want claim-1 statement/claim 2 status=here
% want head-1 proof - proves=claim-1
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\newtheorem{claim}[theorem]{Claim}
\begin{document}
\begin{theorem} Each tree is a graph. \end{theorem}
\begin{proof}
We argue by contradiction.

\begin{claim}\label{c1} Each path is a tree. \end{claim}

\proof    If a path has a cycle, it is not a path. \qed

So the tree is a graph.
\end{proof}
\end{document}
